draft.title: Language and relationships
card: The words we choose show how we see the other person. We talk differently to a principal than to a friend.
full sentences, polite words and titles such as Ms or Dr. It suits people we do not know well or who hold authority.
short phrases, slang and first names or nicknames. It suits friends and family.
Language also shapes a relationship. Using a first name where a title is expected can seem rude, and a very formal tone can make someone seem distant.
draft.remember: Formal or casual words, and the way we address people, show and shape the relationship.

a.q: Zara emails her principal, opening with "Dear Mr Hall" and asking politely, in full sentences, to attend the camp. What does her language show?
opts: A formal, respectful relationship with an authority figure
A close friendship between two equals
Anger about a decision the principal has made
A casual relationship built on shared jokes
a.why: Zara uses a title, a greeting and polite, full sentences. These are formal choices that suit someone in authority. Casual language would use a first name and slang.
a.clue: Look at the title and the polite wording.

b.q: Leo's text to his best friend says: "Yo Benny, you coming to footy or what?" Which rewrite would most shift it towards a formal relationship?
opts: "Dear Benjamin, would you care to attend the match?"
"Hey Ben, are you coming to the footy or what?"
"Yo mate, you coming to footy? Reply soon"
"Benny! Footy today, you in or out?"
b.why: A full name, a greeting and a polite full question are all formal choices. The other options keep nicknames, slang or short phrases, which are casual, even if they change a few words.
b.clue: Which option drops the nickname and slang together?

a.best: A formal, respectful relationship with an authority figure

b.best: "Dear Benjamin, would you care to attend the match?"

problems.detail: The clue 'Which option drops the nickname and slang together?' gives the answer away. Only one option uses neither a nickname nor slang, so students can pick it by checking that feature without judging formality themselves.
